rows.note: This is the everyday choice when you mean checking or making sure that something will happen.

example.english: I’ll ensure the gas is turned off before I leave.
example.traditional: 我出門口之前，會確定煤氣閂好。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceot1 mun4 hau2 zi1 cin4 wui5 kok3 ding6 mui4 hei3 saan1 hou2

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when actively securing a future result or condition.

example.english: The company will take measures to ensure the project is completed on time.
example.traditional: 公司會採取措施，確保工程按時完成。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 wui5 coi2 ceoi2 cou3 si1 kok3 bou2 gung1 cing4 on3 si4 jyun4 sing4
